title: Artificial Intelligence using Python
overview: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Artificial Intelligence (AI) using Python, covering key AI concepts such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision. Participants will learn how to build AI models from scratch, optimize performance, and deploy AI-powered applications. Hands-on programming with Python libraries like TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn, and OpenCV will be a core part of the training.
audience: Software Developers looking to integrate AI into applications
Data Scientists & Analysts exploring machine learning techniques
AI Enthusiasts & Researchers wanting to understand AI fundamentals
Students & Professionals aspiring to enter the AI field
methodology: Hands-on Coding Labs – Writing AI models in Python
Live Demonstrations – Implementing AI solutions in real-world scenarios
Case Studies & Industry Applications – Understanding AI in various sectors
Collaborative Learning – Group projects and brainstorming sessions
Capstone Project – Developing an end-to-end AI-powered application
competencies: Fundamentals of Machine Learning & Deep Learning
Building AI Models with TensorFlow, Keras & Scikit-Learn
Deploying AI Models in Production Environments
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand AI concepts, machine learning, and deep learning fundamentals
Write Python scripts for AI model development
Build classification, regression, and clustering models using Scikit-Learn
Implement neural networks with TensorFlow & Keras
Apply AI techniques to NLP, image recognition, and reinforcement learning
Optimize AI models for performance and scalability
Deploy AI applications in real-world environments

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence & Python for AI

items.text: What is Artificial Intelligence? – History, Trends, and Applications
AI vs. Machine Learning vs. Deep Learning
Setting up Python Environment for AI – Jupyter Notebook, Anaconda, Colab
Overview of Python Libraries for AI (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV)
Introduction to Supervised & Unsupervised Learning

outline.title: Module 2: Data Handling & Preprocessing for AI Models

items.text: Loading & Cleaning Datasets – Handling Missing & Noisy Data
Data Normalization, Standardization & Feature Scaling
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) using Matplotlib & Seaborn
Feature Engineering – Encoding Categorical Data, Feature Selection, PCA
Splitting Data for Training & Testing AI Models
Linear & Logistic Regression Models
Decision Trees & Random Forest Classifiers
K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) & Support Vector Machines (SVM)
K-Means Clustering & Hierarchical Clustering
Performance Evaluation – Confusion Matrix, Precision, Recall, F1-Score
Introduction to Neural Networks & Backpropagation
Building Deep Learning Models using TensorFlow & Keras
Activation Functions (ReLU, Sigmoid, Softmax, Tanh)
Optimizing Models – Gradient Descent, Dropout, Batch Normalization
Hyperparameter Tuning using Grid Search & Random Search

outline.title: Module 5: Natural Language Processing (NLP) with Python

items.text: Text Preprocessing – Tokenization, Stopwords, Stemming, Lemmatization
Implementing TF-IDF & Word Embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe, BERT)
Sentiment Analysis using NLTK & Scikit-Learn
Building a Chatbot with NLP & Deep Learning
Text Classification & Named Entity Recognition (NER)

outline.title: Module 6: Computer Vision & Image Processing with OpenCV & TensorFlow

items.text: Introduction to Computer Vision & Image Processing
Image Preprocessing – Resizing, Normalization, Augmentation
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for Image Recognition
Object Detection using YOLO & OpenCV
Face Recognition with Deep Learning Models
Basics of Reinforcement Learning – Rewards & Actions
Implementing Q-Learning & Deep Q-Networks (DQN)
Applications of Reinforcement Learning – Robotics, Game AI
AI Model Optimization Techniques – Regularization, Transfer Learning
Automated Hyperparameter Tuning with Bayesian Optimization

outline.title: Module 8: AI Model Deployment & Cloud Integration

items.text: Exporting & Saving AI Models – Pickle, Joblib, ONNX
Deploying AI Models using Flask, FastAPI & TensorFlow Serving
Hosting AI Models on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud
Building AI-Powered Web & Mobile Applications

outline.title: Module 9: Ethics & Challenges in AI Development

items.text: Bias & Fairness in AI Models
AI Ethics, Privacy, and Security Concerns
Explainable AI (XAI) & Model Interpretability
Future Trends & Career Opportunities in AI
